**Answer: C.** Naturalism (natural law) concerns the underlying values of international society, while positivism concerns the rules themselves as posited by States through consent. The team note, which says naturalism is mainly championed outside Europe and positivism was exclusively European, doesn't change this. It is an overgeneralization, since natural law has deep European roots (Grotius, Vitoria, Aquinas), so D is still wrong.

CONFIDENCE: 82
